enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body and hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a simple flexitarian breakfast of toast and fruit with a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge and take out bread, fruit, and milk. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Fill kettle and turn on. Remove toast from toaster. Put on plate. Cut fruit. Pour hot water into cup and add tea bag. Sit at table. Eat toast and fruit. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing study bag, checking written reminders and the day's to-do list, and confirming the class timetable
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Pick up study bag. Open bag. Place books, laptop, pens, and charger into bag. Zip bag. Pick up written reminders. Read reminders. Pick up to-do list. Read to-do list. Check class timetable. Pick up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and bus from home to the Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Ride train. Get off train. Walk to campus. Enter campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Social Work coursework lectures and tutorials
enriched_activities.desc: Enter classroom. Find seat. Sit down. Take out notebook and pen. Open notebook. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Turn page. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to answer. Write more notes. Check time. Pack up.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a packed flexitarian lunch on campus and resting quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to seating area. Choose seat. Sit down. Open backpack. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Take out utensils. Eat food. Drink from water bottle. Wipe mouth. Close lunch box. Put lunch box in bag. Place bag on floor. Sit quietly.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending afternoon social work seminars and studying in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Enter seminar room. Sit down. Take out notebook. Take notes. Participate in discussion. Pack up. Walk to library. Enter library. Find study table. Sit down. Open laptop. Open textbook. Read. Write notes. Check references. Pack up.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by bus and train
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Ride train. Get off train. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a batch of vegetarian curry and rice while keeping the shared bench tidy
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open fridge. Take out vegetables, rice, and spices. Wash and cut vegetables. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil and vegetables. Stir. Add spices and water. Cover pot. Measure rice and pour into rice cooker. Add water and turn on rice cooker. Wipe bench. Stir curry. Turn off stove and rice cooker.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the kitchen table with a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plate. Spoon curry onto plate. Spoon rice onto plate. Place plate on table. Pour tea into cup. Place cup on table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Cut food. Eat. Drink tea. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes, wiping the bench and putting away the leftover food
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food into bin. Stack dishes. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse. Place in drying rack. Wipe bench. Put leftover food in container. Place container in fridge.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing assignment notes on the computer and reviewing placement paperwork and reminders
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open assignment file. Read notes. Type. Scroll. Open placement paperwork. Read. Make notes. Check reminders. Type more. Save file. Close laptop. Turn off lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and having a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Fill kettle. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out cup. Take out tea bag. Take out snack. Place snack on plate. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Sit at table. Eat snack. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing written study tasks and updating the weekly budget notes in cash-spending records
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open study document. Type. Review notes. Open budget spreadsheet. Enter expenses. Check receipts. Write notes. Save file. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening routine of brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with a photo of the family dog, setting alarms and reminders, then sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Pick up photo. Look at photo. Put photo down. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Set reminders. Put phone down. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
